_doc: Race Week Live cast voices (doc 59 §5). `instruct` is OmniVoice voice design (gender, age, pitch, accent). `pick` names the designed take(s) in D:/ncm-radio/pack/voices/<SPEAKER>/ every line is cloned from; several picks = several voices for that role (DRIVER: different drivers), one chosen per beat. `pick_reference` is the line a pick was designed from when it differs from `reference`. Owner picks 2026-10-08; MARA aud_0_0 (first designs were noise, KB-403; re-auditioned with audition.py, Whisper-verified). Changing a pick re-renders exactly that speaker's clips.

MARA.instruct: female, middle-aged, moderate pitch, american accent
MARA.reference: And here we go. Welcome to Race Week Live. Night City's very first Race Week is officially underway, and honestly? I have been waiting for this my whole life. I'm Mara Velez.
MARA.pick_reference: Welcome to Race Week Live. I'm Mara Velez. Seven days of racing all over Night City, and I have been waiting for this for a very long time.

JULES.instruct: male, middle-aged, low pitch, american accent
JULES.reference: Julian Mercer. Technically, it worked. I didn't say it was a good idea. Those are different questions, and I'd like to see it come back before we call this a success.

IMANI.instruct: female, young adult, high pitch, american accent
IMANI.reference: This is the Race Week news desk. Officials have confirmed the change takes effect immediately. We'll bring you more as it is published.

TOMMY.instruct: male, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent
TOMMY.reference: Tommy Rhee, trackside, and I cannot hear myself think! They're on the grid, engines are up, and the lights are about to go out!

NIA.instruct: female, middle-aged, low pitch, british accent
NIA.reference: Nia Okafor in the garage. We don't know yet. What we can observe is the behaviour, not the configuration underneath it, and those are not the same thing.

DARNELL.instruct: male, middle-aged, very low pitch, american accent
DARNELL.reference: Darnell Price, Watson. Out here nobody cares about lap times. They care whether they can get across the intersection before the next barrier goes up.

CELESTE.instruct: female, young adult, moderate pitch, british accent
CELESTE.reference: Celeste Ward on the money desk. A purse is a promise with a number attached, and today somebody collected on it.

DRIVER.instruct: male, young adult, moderate pitch, canadian accent
DRIVER.reference: Yeah. I don't really know what to say yet. The car was good, the team was good, and I just tried not to mess it up.

SECOND REMOTE FEED.instruct: male, middle-aged, moderate pitch, australian accent
SECOND REMOTE FEED.reference: Second remote feed here. We have the finish on the other side of the city, stand by for the order.
